Implementing the five-element IM operator, plasma coupling, and shunt dynamics requires translating established but multi-part physics into code. The task is simplified to a single mode and direct time-domain simulation, but still demands careful handling of the nonlinear hysteretic behavior to produce correct qualitative changes in attenuation.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of two straightforward stages: calculate optimal shunt parameters from closed-form expressions (output JSON) and run a single-mode simulation with the hysteretic model to generate a CSV. No external data, no specialized tooling; standard Python libraries suffice.
